name: Uses Patch Baseline
description: An SSM managed instance's last patch operation used this patch baseline (managed instance -> baseline): DescribeInstancePatchStates' BaselineId, matched to the baseline's natural key. An AWS-provided baseline (its BaselineId is an ARN) is collected as one node per region shared by every account (ruling Q139a option 2), so the edge reaches it too. A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_patch.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-patch-state).
